extracted.name: Caramelized Turnips
extracted.description: Turnips are simmered until tender, then coated with butter and a little sugar and cooked to sweet perfection.
ingredient_lines: 1 tablespoon butter, or more as needed
instruction_lines: Place turnips, water, and bouillon into a large skillet over medium heat; simmer until water has evaporated and turnips are tender, about 15 minutes.

Stir butter into turnips until melted, then sprinkle with sugar. Gently simmer, stirring occasionally, until butter and sugar cook into a brown, sticky coating on turnips, about 10 minutes. Serve hot.
